issues.title: Monthly and yearly plans on one checkout page
Redirect to own thank-you page after purchase
Privacy policy link in checkout footer

items.description: Customer added a yearly price to the product following support's guidance and confirmed both the monthly and yearly options show at checkout.
evidence: Added. Let me open the checkout... yes, I can see both the monthly and yearly options now.

items.description: Customer set the after-purchase redirect to their own thank-you page following support's guidance and confirmed it works with a test purchase.
evidence: It worked, it took me straight to my thank-you page after the test purchase.

items.description: Support will send the customer a guide on the tax settings so the customer can follow the steps to add GST.
evidence: I'll send you our guide on the tax settings so you can follow the steps.

items.description: Customer will add the privacy policy link to the checkout footer.
evidence: I still need to add my privacy policy link to the checkout footer, I'll do that this week.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call across two recording segments with clear outcomes.
